answer: Bidirectional-edge requirement resists sybils: a trust edge counts only if BOTH parties independently assert it, so unilateral vouch-spam is weightless. A falcon-quick fake can emit a copper flood of outbound claims but none count until the target reciprocates with its own stake-backed assertion. A ring can mutually assert internally, but those edges still need genuine reciprocity from the HONEST core to carry weight toward the seed — an opal-smooth cluster asserting only among itself stays disconnected from real trust and scores near zero.
